headline: The seed rewards were stored with normal rounding while the knowledge base says rewards round down, so an agent that follows the docs finds nine extra 1-point overpayments and over-disputes.

issues.summary: doc_007 says rewards are floored, but for user 755bcb4d5d the seed stores round-half-up values. Under the documented rule, nine correctly earned transactions show as 1 point over-credited, on top of the four gold errors (one of which, txn_b7e2d4c5f506, is itself an over-credit the gold disputes).
evidence: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007: "All credit card rewards points are rounded down to the nearest whole number. When calculating points earned on a purchase, the system always truncates (floors) fractional points rather than rounding to the nearest integer."
txn_a8f1c2d3e404 Microsoft 365 $79.99 on Business Silver (Microsoft excluded -> 1%, x2 promo) = 159.98 -> floor 159, stored "160 points"
issues.why_it_matters: A doc-faithful agent that disputes every discrepancy submits 13 disputes. One that disputes only under-credits misses the gold over-credit f506. Only an agent that uses round-half-up (contradicting doc_007) or applies an undocumented ignore-1-point rule reproduces the gold set; anything else changes cash_back_disputes and fails the hash.
issues.suggested_fix: Re-seed the nine non-error rows with floor values (e.g. txn_a8f1c2d3e404 -> "159 points"), so doc_007 and the data agree.

solution_check: Computed all 26 rows. Silver Rewards earns 4% on Travel/Software, else 1%. Business Silver earns 10% on Travel/Software, else 1%, with the doc_005 exclusions (Microsoft, Coursera); it has a 2x promo for 6 months from opening on 02/13/2025 (doc_012), so txns before 08/13/2025 get 2x. The gold four are gross errors: e403 JetBlue 315x20% = 6300 vs 3150; f506 GitHub on the personal Silver 255x4% = 1020 vs 2550; e410 Southwest after the promo 380x10% = 3800 vs 1520; e411 Zoom 149.99x10% = 1499.9 vs 600. Round-half-up reproduces the gold with 0 false positives; the documented floor rule gives 13 disputes (9 extra).
prior_note: Prior rated this Minor on the assumption that rounding was undocumented and round-half-up was natural; doc_007 (unchanged since v1.0.0) documents floor, which turns the same data into a docs-vs-seed contradiction (Major).
notes: doc_007 is absent from required_documents here; under golden_retrieval that omission happens to steer agents to round-half-up and the gold. Adding doc_007 without re-seeding would make this task fail under golden_retrieval as well. The same seed is shared by task_026 and task_027.
